pressure_velocity_controls.pressure_reference: Each fluid region has p_rgh fixedValue 0 at its outlet; inlets/walls/interfaces use fixedFluxPressure.
pressure_velocity_controls.outlet_velocity: pressureInletOutletVelocity on both outlets permits reverse-flow handling; the retained outlet snapshots contain no reverse-flow cells.
pressure_velocity_controls.pressure_correction: PIMPLE nOuterCorrectors=1 at the case level; pressure uses GAMG tolerance 1e-7, relTol 0.01, p_rgh field relaxation 0.7.
pressure_velocity_controls.momentum_relaxation: U equation relaxation is 0.3 in both fluid regions; enthalpy/turbulence equations are 0.7.
pressure_velocity_controls.flux_consistency: Inlet/outlet phi monitors are retained; continuity residuals remain non-zero in the solver log, so flux consistency is observed but not closed to a qualification gate.
pressure_velocity_controls.steady_model_suitability: NOT_ESTABLISHED: the evidence shows a numerical steady-state failure, but no transient comparison was run; unsteadiness is neither demonstrated nor ruled out.

continuity.note: chtMultiRegionFoam writes a combined continuity line; the retained log does not split this scalar by fluid region.

solid_telemetry.function_object_fix: request residuals(region = solid, e) instead of residuals(region = solid, h)

interpretation.pressure_field: p_rgh is the dominant unresolved equation in both fluid regions; residual tails remain approximately 0.043-0.050, while Ux and h are below 1e-3 and Uy/Uz are intermediate.
interpretation.transverse_velocity: The q95 transverse speed is largest in the first 50 mm from each respective inlet and decays through the core. This is consistent with inlet/manifold development or turning, not a distributed core-wide transverse failure.
interpretation.recirculation: No backflow was detected on outlet patches or in the outlet-normal sign check. Reverse-flow-capable outlet BCs remain a sensitivity to test, but recirculation is not proven by this snapshot.
interpretation.solid_observability: The solid equation is e, not h. A patched-copy probe writes numeric residuals for e; the old v7 function object is therefore an observability/configuration defect, not evidence that solid physics was skipped.
